system.description: Base Essence (Elemental Companion) 5.7.1 - Air Control. Spells built around Force (compressed air): dust devils that race toward a target delivering Unbalancing criticals, wind/air bolts, immobilizing bands, walking or building constructs of solid air (bridges, platforms, walls, domes, fields), and a vibrating cone shockwave. Special note from the source: Force is air compressed down to 1/100% of its size - extremely hard and resilient; Light-based attacks and Light Elementals (at least 70 corruption points) are completely immune to and ignore the effects of Force.
Target is buffeted by focused strong winds. All actions made by target are at -30.

A dust devil forms in front of the caster and races towards target. Those in the path of the dust devil have a 50% chance of getting hit. Target and those who get in its path must resist or take a 'B' Unbalancing critical.
Strong winds flow from the caster's arm, striking target. Resolve attack on the Airbolt Table.

Caster envelops target with bands of force, which immobilizes target. Target can make a Very Hard Strength maneuver every round to act normally, otherwise they are at 20% activity. One man-sized target can be bound for every five levels of the caster. Caster must concentrate.
As Dust Devil I, except 'C' Unbalancing criticals are delivered.
Target can walk on air as if it was solid ground. This spell only allows for horizontal movement; vertical movement must be achieved by other means.
A bolt of force is shot from the caster's palm. Results are determined on the Force Bolt table.
Caster summons a 20 foot radius intense burst of air on target point. Results are determined on the Cold Ball table delivering Unbalancing criticals instead of Cold criticals.

Creates a clear wall of force. All attacks through the wall are at -100. No being can pass through the wall unless they make a Very Hard maneuver modified by strength. Wall is a manifestation of High Elemental Air. Air based beings, attacks and spells are only at -50 and it is only a Hard maneuver to go through the wall.
Caster summons a shimmering plane of force 20 feet long by 5 feet wide. Plane is immobile and can support up to 1000 pounds. Force Bridge only needs one of its sides resting on a solid surface.
Caster creates a five-foot radius disk of force. Disk can move up to 100 feet per round in any direction, if the caster concentrates. When caster stops concentrating the disk stops moving.
A bolt of High Elemental Air is fired from the caster's palm, results are resolved on the Huge Bash Attack Table.

Creates a shimmering field of force 1' around the caster. If caster concentrates this spell increases his defensive bonus 100 versus all physical and elemental attacks. If caster ceases concentrating then the defensive bonus is only 20.
As Dust Devil I, except target takes a 'E' Unbalancing critical.
As Force Wall, except for duration.
Creates a clear dome of force. Dome has a ten-foot radius and completely encloses area. Treat the effects of the dome as a Force Wall.
As Force Wall, except for duration.
Target item is surrounded by a 1' radius sphere of force. Item can only be seen and not touched for the duration. Item must fit inside of the sphere or the spell fails.
As Force Binding, except targets that are constrained take an 'A' Krush critical each round.
As Air Walking, except it affects one target per level of the caster.

A cone of vibrating force erupts from the caster's palm. Cone is 100 feet long and 10 feet wide at its base. Resolve attack on the Fireball Table delivering Impact criticals instead of the normal Heat criticals.

Creates a shimmering field of force 1' around the target. If caster concentrates this spell increases target's defensive bonus 150 versus all physical and elemental attacks. If caster ceases concentrating then the defensive bonus is only 50.
As Force Field II, except caster need not concentrate to get the full benefit of the spell.
